llc.title: Articles of Organization (LLC)
llc.summary: Form a limited liability company in Arden.

pages.title: Name
pages.intro: The name must end with LLC, L.L.C. or Limited Liability Company and be distinguishable from every name on the register.

fields.name: entity_name
fields.label: Name of the limited liability company

pages.title: Principal office
pages.intro: Where the business is run from. It is public.

pages.title: Registered agent
pages.intro: The person or company in Arden that accepts legal papers for the business. It may be you.

fields.name: agent_address
fields.label: Registered agent's street address
fields.hint: A physical address in Arden: Street, City, AN ZIP. Not a P.O. box.

fields.name: agent_consent
fields.label: The registered agent has agreed to serve

rules.reason: {{entity_name}} is not distinguishable from a name already on the register.
The registered agent's address must be a physical street address; a post office box ({{value}}) cannot receive service of process (Arden Rev. Stat. 10-501).
The registered agent must have a street address in Arden, written as Street, City, AN ZIP; {{value}} is not.
The registered agent has to agree to serve before we can file the entity.

letter.subject: Certificate of Organization: {{entity_name}}

notice.subject: Annual report past due: {{record_name}}
notice.body:
Dear {{owner}},

The {{period}} for {{record_name}} (entity {{record}}) was due {{due}}, and we have not received it. The entity is now delinquent on the register.

File the report online at sos.arden.gov.example; a report filed late is charged a $50.00 late fee. If it is still not filed 60 days after the due date, the entity will be administratively dissolved and lose the right to its name.

lapse_letter.subject: Notice of administrative dissolution: {{record_name}}
lapse_letter.body:
Dear {{owner}},

{{record_name}} (entity {{record}}) did not file its {{period}}, due {{due}}, within 60 days. Under the Arden Revised Statutes the Secretary of State has administratively dissolved the entity. It may apply for reinstatement by filing every overdue report with the fees and penalties owed.

rejected.subject: Articles of Organization rejected: case {{case}}
rejected.body:
Dear {{applicant}},

We could not file the Articles of Organization for {{entity_name}} (case {{case}}):

{{reasons}}

The filing fee is not refundable. You may file again with a different name.
